title: Doctor Body Picture Book
hook: One picture can teach anatomy without diagnosing anyone.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D body-learning storybook, non-graphic anatomy models and everyday wellness cues, clean shapes; visual identity: Doctor Body Picture Book

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child reading a doctor body book, not acting as clinician
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: anatomy/care target -> clinical context -> professional boundary
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: picture recall -> target -> point-only for medical items
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Doctor Body Picture Book a clinical-literacy picture book: anatomy words, symptoms/signs, physical exam, imaging and dressings are separated, with no child self-diagnosis or pretend procedure.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child learns what a clinician might observe or image while every medical conclusion remains contextual and professional.
